newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus repo yield drops to 4.46 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus repo yield drops to 4.46 percent.

text.p: The average yield on a repo auction between Cyprus's central bank and commercial banks on Tuesday was 4.46 percent, dropping slightly from Monday's 4.48 percent, the central bank said.
Bids for bills worth 23.9 million Cyprus pounds were made for the 27.0 million pounds worth of bills on offer.
The bank sold bills worth 23.9 million pounds, with yields ranging from 4.13 percent to 4.65 percent, a statement from the central bank said.
